items.name: Please Be Quiet Brisbane 2024

venue.name: Northside Christian College
venue.address: 151 Flockton St, Everton Park QLD 4053, Australia

items.information:
![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png)

Please note, this competition includes only blindfolded events, clock and FMC. If you are interested in non-blindfolded events we recommend signing up to the [Speedcubing Australia mailing list](https://speedcubing.org.au/subscribe/) to be notified as new competitions are announced.

Competitors are strongly encouraged to bring a guest who is familiar with the process of judging blindfolded solving.

This will be allocated on a first-come-first serve basis in order of payment.

**Contact us**
We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)!

[Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)

Speedcubing Australia acknowledges the traditional owners of this land, the Jagera and Turrbal people, and pays respect to the elders, past and present for they hold the memories, the traditions, the culture and hopes of Aboriginal Australia.

items.name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 61 - San Jose 2024
items.information:
BASC is proud to host a competition in San Jose again! Join us at Andrew P. Hill High School for a jam-packed day of speedcubin'
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3RaIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--dfb7c40e4726a4e50ed5a25058aa0a73ec95b070/wcc-banner.png)
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3BaIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8d2ce427e5b4eee60c1f5d187a10c67246d67089/timebase.png)
- This competition will be using the new revolutionary score-taking technology, **TimeBase**! We will be using traditional scorecards but will be offering a newer, paperless scoretaking experience for all registered competitors!
- *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.*
- We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info.
- This competition is sponsored by **TheCubicle**! Check out the "Sponsor" tab for more information.
